comments.body: This is confusing, since `lastResults` gets set right before firing the `search` event. Do you have a way to reproduce this in a sandbox? Thanks for this PR already though!
@Haroenv I'll try and reproduce with CodeSandbox.

I think I see how this can happen, it would be if the very first search is stalled, since this is the `search` event, not the `result` event

https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/67407a0dfd99402bc1a77bd005385633c3881624/src/algoliasearch.helper.js#L1195-L1198

Would need to check if we already have a test for this though, I feel like not having results woful be a straightforward way to write this test.

We probably want to render `null` or something for the results, and not with && like here, since that will return a different object

Even if the true reasons of the problem are undetermined, if this PR is fixing your problem and since the change is harmless, I'm for merging it.

We'll release a maintenance version of `instantsearch.js` v3 with this fix.

However, if you find more information on how is case occurs on you production application please share it with us :slightly_smiling_face:

Thinking more about this, while I do like the initiative here, I think `lastResults` will still be `null` in problematic cases here. If this actually fixes your issue, so be it, but I don't think it's fully fixed yet
@Haroenv I agree with your point. This measure is only a band-aid on the actual issue. Something is causing `lastResults` to be null. Unfortunately I was unable to reproduce this in a sandbox.

in v4 we have this solved as `if (!this._isSearchStalled && !this._searchStalledTimer) {` is changed to `if (!this._isSearchStalled && !this._searchStalledTimer && this.helper.lastResults) {` and leaving the rest as-is. This will mean the render will no longer happen and can't cause errors
Are you suggesting this solution for v3?
yes, I'm suggesting this solution for the current branch on which you are
@Haroenv Are you goint to merge into v3?

Sorry @celtian, v3 has been released years ago, and this issue is fixed in v3. Sorry to @chrisbradleydev for losing track of this PR, but I don't think it still makes sense to release a v3 version now. Is there a reason you didn't yet update to v4? It's much smaller and has many more features, minimal breaking changes!

title: fix: ensure lastResults object exists
